metadata.analyzer: Whole-source Unicode letter/number token start, letter/number/mark continuation; per-token NFKC then lowercase; no stemming/stopwords/fuzzy.
metadata.content: Original body string or body values joined by newline; metadata is not indexed. Array boundary/phrase/source/offset semantics are Not comparable.
metadata.output: Full engine-ranked ID list; complete total derived from full list. ID extraction/validation and await overhead included; no application eligibility/ranking or truncation.
metadata.ranking: Each library native ranking and tie order retained. Scores/order are not required equal to Raveldex BM25.
metadata.lifecycle: Read-only built index. Atomic mutation, cancellation, worker, persistence and revision semantics are Not comparable.
metadata.flexsearch: One strict-token Index with custom encoder and cache disabled. Prefix is Not comparable in this exact-token configuration; native Resolver handles simple OR.
